name: B10-0263/2026 (S&D) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Iran's crackdown on protesters and political prisoners. It asks Iran to stop all executions immediately, release detained minors, and allow independent investigations into deaths and sexual violence in detention. It wants the European Union to widen sanctions against officials responsible, help Iranians get free internet access, and open asylum routes for those facing persecution. It also condemns attacks on Iranian Kurdish refugees in Iraq. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the European Union and Iran to act.
- **Who it affects:** Iranian protesters, prisoners, minorities, and officials facing possible sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, Commission and Iranian authorities for response.
